answers.question: State Bayes' theorem.
answers.answer_excerpt:
Bayes’ theorem states that the posterior probability of \(x\) given an observed \(y\) is  

\[
p(x \mid y)=\frac{p(y \mid x)\,p(x)}{p(y)} .
\]

(“Mathematics for Machine Learning”, p. 191)
